data.long_meaning: Sacchidanand is a name of God, meaning 'He who is the embodiment of truth, consciousness, and bliss'. It is a Sanskrit name, derived from the words 'sacchid' (truth) and 'anand' (bliss). This name signifies the eternal, unchanging nature of the divine, and evokes feelings of peace, purity, and happiness.
